bodies.name: Assembleia da República (Portuguese Parliament)
bodies.layout: Legacy ASP.NET/SharePoint institutional portal: a thin accessibility/skip-nav utility bar sits above a language switcher (English, Français, Versão áudio) and Contactos link, followed by a header with the AR crest logo and a mega-menu style main nav (Parlamento, Deputados, Atividade parlamentar, Comissões, UE e Internacional) that expands into nested Bootstrap-style accordions. Below the header is a large rotating image carousel promoting prizes, exhibitions and events, followed by three small square promo tiles (Consulta pública, Cidadania e participação, Comunicação). A DESTAQUES (Highlights) section lists dated announcement links, and the page ends in a tabbed live-agenda dashboard widget with tabs for TRABALHOS DO DIA, VOTAÇÕES, INICIATIVAS ENTRADAS and EM APRECIAÇÃO PÚBLICA.
ui_patterns: Accessibility skip-menu note announcing keyboard shortcuts before any visual content
Nested multi-level Bootstrap accordion mega-menu for parliamentary sub-sections
Dated 'DESTAQUES' (highlights) carousel mixing prizes, hearings, ceremonies and consultations as undifferentiated announcement tiles
Tabbed 'live business' dashboard (TRABALHOS DO DIA / VOTAÇÕES / INICIATIVAS ENTRADAS / EM APRECIAÇÃO PÚBLICA) styled like a legislative status board
Per-committee microsites addressed by legislature-and-committee-code URL paths (e.g. /sites/com/XVIILeg/1CACDLG)
ASP.NET WebForms postback control naming exposed in the DOM
Archive/arquivo pattern for superseding 'current' content with a historical listing link
Trilingual utility bar (PT/English/Français) plus an 'audio version' accessibility toggle

bodies.name: Governo de Portugal / XXV Governo Constitucional (Portuguese Government / PM Office)
bodies.layout: Modern Next.js-rendered portal (assets served from /_next/) themed as the 'XXV Governo Constitucional' site. The header carries the Government of Portugal wordmark/logo linking to the 25th Constitutional Government hub, beneath which sits a full-width rotating banner carousel of current news/alerts (e.g. heat-wave alert, national mourning notice, PRR presentation, armed forces reinforcement). A 'Nas Redes Sociais' (On Social Media) section embeds an Instagram post and a link to Council of Ministers communiqués/briefings. A 'Programas' section highlights flagship initiatives like the Orçamento do Estado (State Budget). The footer-adjacent 'Serviços do Estado' section links out to the unified citizen services portal (gov.pt), health service (SNS), tax authority (Finanças), social security and justice portals, and the page closes with PRR/NextGenerationEU/República Portuguesa co-branding logos.
ui_patterns: Full-bleed rotating alert/news carousel immediately below the masthead used for both routine news and emergency civil-protection alerts (heat-wave, national mourning)
'Nas Redes Sociais' embedded social-media proof-of-activity module (Instagram post preview)
'Serviços do Estado' cross-portal link grid federating out to independently-branded sibling government domains (gov.pt, sns.gov.pt, portaldasfinancas.gov.pt, seg-social.pt, justica.gov.pt)
EU funding co-branding footer strip (PRR, República Portuguesa, NextGenerationEU logos shown together)
Constitutional-government versioning baked into the URL/branding (gc25 = 25th Constitutional Government) so the whole site identity resets each government term
'Comunicados e Briefings do Conselho de Ministros' as a persistent sidebar promo linking to Council of Ministers press output
Next.js image proxy pattern (/_next/image?url=...) wrapping all editorial imagery served from a headless CMS backend

bodies.name: Procuradoria-Geral da República / Ministério Público (Public Prosecution Service) - used as replacement for Polícia Judiciária (pj.pt), which returned no content after two attempts
bodies.layout: Drupal 10 institutional portal (theme: javali_theme) for the Procuradoria-Geral da República / Ministério Público. Header holds the PGR/MP logo, a search field, and a PT/English/Español language switcher, above a deep multi-level dropdown mega-menu (Ministério Público, Procuradoria-Geral da República, MP no país, O que fazemos, Cidadão, Legislação Documentação) that fans out into órgãos, magistrados and per-district/comarca sub-pages. The body opens with an institutional mission paragraph, then two parallel news rails — 'Notícias - Atividade do MP' and 'Últimas - MP no País' — listing dated press items with 'Saber mais' read-more links, followed by a quick-action strip (Corrupção/denúncia, Apostila services) and an 'Agenda da Procuradoria-Geral da República' block. The footer is a structured link grid (Imprensa, Legislação, Informação, Mais sobre nós) plus a physical address/contact card and closes with Área Reservada, Acessibilidade, Política de Privacidade and Mapa do Site legal links.
ui_patterns: Institutional mission-statement paragraph placed directly on the homepage above the news feed
Dual parallel news rails distinguishing central-office news from nationwide/district-office news ('Notícias - Atividade do MP' vs 'Últimas - MP no País')
Anonymous corruption-reporting call-to-action tile ('Corrupção — Faça a sua denúncia aqui') placed as a first-class homepage widget, not buried in menu
District/comarca structure exposed as an enormous flat list of regional sub-domain links (comarca-braga.ministeriopublico.pt, comarca-faro.ministeriopublico.pt, etc.)
Numbered 'Boletim Informativo n.º X/2026' bulletin format used repeatedly for governance-body meeting minutes
'Operação [Codename]' press-release naming convention for law-enforcement actions (e.g. Operação Eclipse, Operação Jet Lag)
Consistent four-item legal/meta footer bar: Área Reservada, Acessibilidade, Política de Privacidade, Mapa do Site
Developer credit line in the footer attributing the Drupal build to an external agency
